mentions.name: family debts
mentions.description: A Google Spreadsheet titled "family debts" that lets the author's family record when they owe each other money and periodically settle up; used constantly for splitting gifts and store purchases, with over a thousand entries.
mentions.problem: Keeping track of small debts among family members (gifts, store purchases) and settling them up.
mentions.audience: Trusted family group (siblings and parents) who lend and split money with each other
mentions.source_excerpt: Back in 2019 I created a Google Spreadsheet titled "family debts" that allows my family (4 siblings and my parents) to record when we owe each other money, and periodically settle up.

evidence.value: Back in 2019 I created a Google Spreadsheet titled "family debts" that allows my family (4 siblings and my parents) to record when we owe each other money, and periodically settle up.
